plan_title: sendFilePart base64→multipart/form-data 二进制 + number_of_parts 契约对齐

steps.title: createMultiPartUpload 补 number_of_parts 参数 (F2)
steps.change: createMultiPartUpload(filename, contentType, fileSize, apiKey, numberOfParts) — body 补 number_of_parts: numberOfParts
steps.rationale: Context7 OpenAPI: multi_part 模式须声明 number_of_parts(1-10000)，须与最终 part_number 匹配

steps.title: sendFilePart 改 multipart/form-data 二进制 (F1)
steps.change: sendFilePart(uploadId, partBlob, partNumber, apiKey, filename) 改为：构造 multipart/form-data body (boundary + file field: filename+Uint8Array + part_number field) + GM_xmlhttpRequest binary:true + endpoint /file_uploads/{id}/send + Authorization: Bearer apiKey + Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary
steps.rationale: Context7: send endpoint 用 multipart/form-data unique，file field=binary。仿 uploadFileContent:931 模式但走 Notion API endpoint + Bearer auth（非 S3 预签名）
steps.body_construction:
boundary=crypto.getRandomValues(8 bytes hex prefix); header=`--boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="{filename}"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

`; partNumberField=`
--boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="part_number"

{partNumber}
`; footer=`--boundary--
`; 拼接 header+uint8Array+partNumberField+footer 为 Uint8Array body

steps.title: uploadFileToNotion multi_part loop 去 base64 + 传 numberOfParts (F1+F2)

steps.rationale: 消除 base64 膨胀 + 对齐 number_of_parts 契约
